summary: Battle resolution rehonors a dishonorable army only in place of an actual Honor gain from destroying opposing cards (GainResolutionHonor): the winner's twice-the-cards gain and Plains of the Maiden's gain. No gain (undefended province, withheld gain, Aramasu's Legacy) rehonors nobody. Ties unchanged (both armies rehonored before destruction). The Earth Flows' bonus now follows only an Honor gain actually made. Ruling R-100.
